svg.title: How Todo Manager works
svg.desc: Your inbox (Gmail, Slack, GitHub; read-only, newsletters skipped) feeds Todo Manager's wake gate every five minutes. Only new material wakes the Hermes LLM judge, which writes task changes to the local SQLite store. Notion sync and the Web UI keep the store in step with what you see, two-way, with your edits winning; other AI agents reach the same tasks through the command line, the HTTP API or the MCP server. A Notion card you drag to Assign to Agent is delegated to a Hermes Kanban agent, whose result comes back to the task; your comments on a task page go back to the LLM judge.
